flags.message: Band semantics note, not a defect: context.json freezes distribution_count=2 / band=elevated, but the first distribution (Conference of 6/11/2026) was superseded by a 'Response Requested' entry on Jun 3 2026 before any conference considered the petition, and the second (Conference of 9/28/2026) is its first real consideration. The dist-v2 count therefore reads a call-for-response redistribution as a relist. If the elevated pool mixes true post-conference relists with CFR redistributions at different grant rates, a cut by how the second distribution arose would sharpen both the anchor and the relist-increment claim. Forecast anchored on the elevated reached rate as instructed.
